risks: No participants; the review does not involve clinic patients. The ethical risk is a clinic decision that invests in digital support many patients cannot use.
consent: Not applicable; no human participants or personal data.
data: Published and publicly available reports only.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: age, income, disability (including intellectual disability), rurality and language are charted for who was offered, who installed and who was excluded, so the clinic can see whether an app-based plan would widen gaps.
effectiveness: Succeeds if the map answers the clinic's five questions by June 2027.
efficiency: Clinic time only; library support within existing services.
partnerships: Neurosciences library, two nurse specialists, and a member of a regional epilepsy charity's advisory group for the plain-language summary.
rebPath: No REB review needed: no human participants or identifiable data. No questionnaire of clinic patients is part of this review.
limitations: English only; engagement definitions may not be comparable; commercial reports may be favourable.
summary: No participants; equity charting makes the access gap visible.
